_doc: Config-driven clusters. Add a new object to 'clusters' to cover a new cluster. 'queries' feed Google News RSS (lang: en|gu|hi). 'aliases' are used to attribute items from generic publisher feeds. Industry 'keywords' are matched on headline+snippet (English: whole word, case-insensitive; Indic: substring).

industries.name: Ceramic tiles
industries.subsegments: Vitrified/GVT, wall & floor tile makers; propane/LPG-fired vs PNG-fired kilns; exporters (Gulf, US, Europe) vs domestic dealers
credit_checks: Fuel type and gas contract (PNG vs propane/LPG, administered vs spot price)
Export share by market and LC/DA terms
Dealer debtor ageing (>90 days drops out of DP)
Kiln/line capex in last 24 months and term-loan EMI cover

industries.name: Sanitaryware
industries.subsegments: Sanitaryware moulding/firing units, brand OEM suppliers, dealers
credit_checks: Share of sales to branded OEMs vs open market
Gas cost per piece and pass-through ability
Inventory build-up in stock statements

industries.name: Kraft / packaging paper
industries.subsegments: Kraft paper mills (waste-paper based), corrugated box makers serving ceramic packaging
credit_checks: Dependence on ceramic-industry box demand
Imported/domestic waste-paper prices and coal/fuel cost
Pollution-control (GPCB) compliance status

industries.name: MMF textiles & trading
industries.subsegments: Grey-fabric traders, processing/dyeing houses, textile market traders (Ring Road), saree/dress-material sellers
credit_checks: Trader debtor ageing and exposure to defaulting buyers (uthamnu)
Processing-house fuel (coal/gas) cost
Seasonal stock build-up before festivals/weddings

industries.name: Weaving & yarn
industries.subsegments: Water-jet/air-jet weavers, powerloom units, yarn spinners/texturisers (POY/FDY buyers)
credit_checks: Yarn purchase pattern (spot vs contracted; old-rate inventory)
Loom utilisation and labour availability
Machinery term loans (TUFS-era) EMI cover

industries.name: Embroidery
industries.subsegments: Computerised embroidery job-workers (small, highly leveraged on machine loans)
credit_checks: Job-work order book and principal concentration
Machine-loan EMI cover at current utilisation

industries.name: Diamonds
industries.subsegments: Natural diamond cutting & polishing units, lab-grown (LGD) growers/polishers, traders/exporters
credit_checks: Natural vs LGD mix and price trend exposure
Export receivables/PCFC ageing (US, HK, UAE)
Rough inventory valuation vs current polished prices
Worker headcount / unit closures
